name: Töttös (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner with two horizontal bands of green and yellow at the bottom, charged near the top with the municipal arms of Töttös (a red and white shield with ears of grain and a plough) within a green wreath, above a scroll inscribed TÖTTÖS.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Töttös arms with wreath and scroll
